notes.content: Update the game and choose the 2nd launch option to play the NEW MODE :D

notes.title: Real time urine accumulation coming soon!
notes.content:
Innovative real time liquid simulation + destruction for Toilet Simulator. Indie gets to a whole new level. You wish AAA games had these features. 
Pee gets accumulated. 
Character can get drown in urine. After urine reaches a critical mass - floor gets destructed under weight of the liquid and character falls into someone's apartment where people 
If character decides to keep peeing - he will break the floor again.
This is one of the first implementations of newest real time liquid technologies in video games.
So if not for the sake of comedic value, you may want to try the game for experiencing real time liquids like a tech demo, in a pretty appropriate scenario.
There are no projects I know that have real time liquid simulation, so praise us, one of the pioneers.
Also, this is so surrealistic it is worth an award for creativity and immersion. The game gives you an opportunity to experience things you never could in real life, in an associative environment making you believe something that surreal is happening in reality. 

Coming on 10/02/2019

notes.title: Battle royale mode, racing. Modes reveal
notes.content:
I am ready to announce the game's new upcoming modes lists 

1. Battle royale.
Mount a toilet and pee like sniper.
In this mode you ll shoot poo out of ass and will have to kill everyone with poo and pee.

2. Racing mode:
Mount a toilet and use the kinetic power of fart to move you forward and compete with up to 4 players!

3. Hard poo mode:
Characters have a really sturdy poo. So who ll poop faster wins! Upgrade your characters pooping apparatus to poop faster, gain perks.

4. Free standing pee

5. Different toilet maps:
Public toilet
Luxury golden toilet
University toilet
Metro toilet
Eastern toilet
Village toilet(sortir)
Transparent room toilet


6. With some of the Nvidia technology, I will be adding an abiloity to get drawn pee that will fill the entire toilet.

7. VR mode
8. Random character body

9. Ray tracing will be added in late february.

10. 9D mode. Play the game inside toilet.
You ll have a vr headset ingame and laptop on your knees both in game and real life. Total immersion. 
Also I am trying to get FeelReal for smell simulation

11. Poop with your friends
